# Game music archive fixture

`solid-rar5.rsn` contains two synthetic SPC tones and a `notes.txt` member.
It contains no game assets. The SPC data comes from `game_music_fixtures.h`:

```cpp
game_fixtures::save("01.spc", game_fixtures::spc("First"));
game_fixtures::save("02.spc", game_fixtures::spc("Second", 0x800));
game_fixtures::save("notes.txt", {'h', 'i'});
```

Created with RAR 7.22 using:

```
rar a -ma5 -s -m5 -idq solid-rar5.rsn notes.txt 01.spc 02.spc
```

The stored fixture allows the test suite to check that unsupported RAR5
archives produce a clear error without requiring an archiver at build or runtime. RAR4 stored and
solid-header fixtures are generated by `game_music_fixtures.h`; real compressed
RAR4 RSNs can be checked with `game-music-smoke <path-to-rsn>`.

`browser.zip` and `browser.7z` contain only synthetic fixtures created by
`make_archive_sources.cpp`: two SPC tones, a VGZ tone, a nested RSN and notes.
To regenerate, compile that source with C++20 and zlib, run it in an empty
directory, then run (7-Zip 26.02 was used):

```
7z a -tzip -mx=9 browser.zip folder 02.spc notes.txt
7z a -t7z -mx=9 -ms=on browser.7z folder 02.spc notes.txt
```

The ZIP uses Deflate; the solid 7z uses LZMA2. No archiver is needed to run tests.

[retrovertapp/playback-pretracker revision c8a4cdc](https://github.com/retrovertapp/playback-pretracker/blob/c8a4cdc7de3319e2f8d2e02d0b6fbd09e3cf5f4d/fixtures/retrovert_selftest.prt).
